"""Fixture triage cron (synthetic).

A fabricated cron body standing in for a crash-triage policy. Nothing here
runs; the docstring below is the span a citation row quotes.
"""
FIXTURE_THRESHOLD = 7


def should_file(crash) -> bool:
    """File when the crash reproduced on each of the last N fixture days and
    its fixture crash total crossed the threshold."""
    return crash.days_seen >= FIXTURE_THRESHOLD and crash.total > FIXTURE_THRESHOLD
